questions.s: Which statement about states of matter is correct?
o: When a liquid reaches its boiling point, it becomes a gas. This process is called evaporation.
When a gas condenses, it becomes a liquid and energy is lost to the surroundings.
When a solid changes directly to a gas, the process is called deposition.
When a solid melts, the particles get further apart and have less energy.

questions.s: Which statement is typical of a solid non-metal element?
o: It has more than one oxidation state.

questions.s:
The statements below describe elements X and Y.
An atom of X has more protons than an atom of Y.
An atom of Y has more valence electrons than an atom of X.
Particles of X and Y combine to form an ionic structure.
Which of the following statements can be deduced based on the statements above?
o: An atom of X has more electron shells than an atom of Y.
X and Y are in the same period of the Periodic Table.
X and Y are in the same group of the Periodic Table.

questions.s:
The Haber process is used to make ammonia at a temperature of 450 °C and a pressure of 200 atm. The temperature is changed to 700 °C but the pressure is kept the same.

It is made at an increased rate and the yield decreases.
It is made at a decreased rate and the yield increases.
It is made at a decreased rate and the yield decreases.
